single_variable: Extra physical position slots to retain older, 25% residual cloud runners after the resting 2R order fills. There are always at most nine full entries still awaiting a target or stop. A new signal can only use cash released before its entry hour. Simultaneous signals preserve prior ATR priority and the frozen one-open-position-per-contract rule.
allocation: Fund new entries with min(current open NAV/9, current available collateral / number of currently available full-entry slots). The number of available full-entry slots is the minimum of physically flat slots and nine minus occupied first legs. Long/short collateral segregated, free cash only, no leverage. Existing partial and runner quantities remain fixed.
development_choice: Rank by development terminal NAV through 2024 among rules with at least 100 funded trades, >=30% winners, equal-notional realized net payoff >=2.5 and hourly drawdown bound <=35%. Fallback is zero spare slots. Stress and parent-paired controls for selected and unconstrained dev leader if different from inherited baseline. No tuning on 2025 and 2026, both previously inspected.
